section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)

content.description: Illustration showing removal of snap ring and one-way clutch from planetary gears, and removal of nylon thrust washer from planetary gears

content.text: 5. REMOVE SNAP RING AND ONE-WAY CLUTCH FROM PLANETARY GEARS
6. REMOVE NYLON THRUST WASHER FROM PLANETARY GEARS
7. REMOVE APPLY TUBE AND CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE

content.description: Illustration showing compression of shaft snap ring and removal of front planetary ring gear using snap ring pliers

content.text: 8. COMPRESS SHAFT SNAP RING AND REMOVE FRONT PLANETARY RING GEAR
While pulling up the ring gear, compress the snap ring with snap ring pliers and pull out the ring gear by hand.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of intermediate shaft, ring gear and planetary gear from output shaft assembly

content.text: 9. REMOVE INTERMEDIATE SHAFT, RING GEAR AND PLANETARY GEAR FROM OUTPUT SHAFT ASSEMBLY

content.description: Illustration showing removal of thrust bearing and races from output shaft assembly, with note about position of races

content.text: 10. REMOVE THRUST BEARING AND RACES FROM OUTPUT SHAFT ASSEMBLY
Note the position of the races.
11. REMOVE THREE OIL SEAL RINGS FROM OUTPUT SHAFT

content.description: Illustration showing removal of steel thrust washer and rear pinion gears from intermediate shaft assembly, and removal of race and thrust bearing from intermediate shaft

content.text: 12. REMOVE STEEL THRUST WASHER AND REAR PINION GEARS FROM INTERMEDIATE SHAFT ASSEMBLY
13. REMOVE RACE AND THRUST BEARING FROM INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
Note the position of the race.
